noah_ito_3850

I want to change the shipping address for that order to my New York address. It’s already saved in my account from another order. Also, I want to swap the silicone watch for a metal one—if there are color options, I’d like white.

Got it, Noah. I can help with both:

2) **Swap one silicone watch to a metal watch** (white color if available).

Before I can make any changes, please send:

1) **Your order id** (e.g., `#W0000000`).

I don’t have the order ID handy, but the New York address is already saved in my account from a previous order. Can you just use that one? And I only want to swap one of the watches—the silicone one—for a metal one in white, if that’s an option.
